standing.untilComplete: I separately authorize continuing the approved scope until all required phases and terminal verification are complete, including beyond the planning target.
standing.blockRenewal: I separately authorize automatic renewal of work blocks lasting at most 24 hours each. Renewal cannot override pause, cancellation, unresolved waits, exhausted attempts, uncertain native delivery or permission boundaries.

authorization.target: Planning target: I authorize a target 14 days after the actual project start. Record its exact timestamp in Europe/Kiev. This is a planning target, not a hard execution deadline or release promise.
authorization.retention: Retain the active coordinator through each PR's merge, independent acceptance and terminal results. Arm no unattended wake. If the session is interrupted, reconcile the same project before continuing. Do not promise after-session monitoring.
